text: I purchased a home from in XXXX of 2023 through a lender named XXXXXXXX XXXX. However, my Mortgage was sold to Lakeview Mortgage. Apparently, through this process, my information was compromised from a data breach. The company mailed out a letter entailing the incident. Therefore, when I noticed a significant drop on my credited rating, I contacted the mortgage company ( Lakeview Loan Service ). Lakeview loan Services refused to help me resolve my issue. I was transferred to several different operators who refused to address the data breach issues. I demand to speak to a supervisor all they did was give me the run around. No one in their administration office or management contacted about this data breach.
